claims.claim: on the training provided (including its effectiveness and the number of employees trained)

claims.claim: The bill mandates trafficking-detection training
claims.sourceSpan: the Secretary of Labor shall implement a program to provide the training

claims.claim: but provides no dedicated funding for the program
claims.note: Absence-observation: the source contains no appropriation, authorization of appropriations, or funding provision. Accurate identification of a gap; no backing span (verified by full-text absence).

claims.claim: It requires referral of suspected cases to the Department of Justice
claims.sourceSpan: a clear course of action for referring potential cases of human trafficking to the Department of Justice
claims.note: Bill requires the TRAINING to include a clear referral pathway (and Sec. 4 reports referred cases); it does not impose a blanket duty to refer every case. Slight overstatement.

claims.claim: but does not address what happens to workers identified as potential victims
claims.sourceSpan: in accordance with best practices for protecting the rights of victims of human trafficking, including appropriate collaboration with victim advocacy organizations
claims.note: Defensible gap re: substantive relief/outcomes for identified workers, but partially qualified by the source clause requiring referrals follow best practices for protecting victims' rights and collaboration with victim advocacy orgs.

notes: Source audited = data/bill-text/119-HR-4307.txt (H.R. 4307 Introduced in House / IH, 4692 chars). cache.versionChanges records "unchanged: true" through Engrossed in House, so the IH text is substantively the text that passed the House. No referencedSources registered. No dollar figures in the bill; only deadlines (180 days, 1 year). No direction inversions, wrong figures, fabricated entities, or wrong attributions found. All statutory cites verify verbatim (22 U.S.C. 7102; 29 U.S.C. 203(l); TVPA 2000; FLSA 1938). featured_quotes (Mr. Moylan) is a Congressional Record quote with no CR source file registered, so it was NOT source-verifiable and is out of audit scope. Separate observation (not a prose claim): cache billType is "amendment", but this is a freestanding new Act (creates a new DOL training program; no strike/insert amendatory text) — taxonomy field, outside the prose-fidelity scope of this audit.
